description: Hamburg's inspection plan under section 17 of the German Hazardous Incident Ordinance sets out how the city's environment authority inspects the establishments covered by the Seveso III Directive, and its annex lists every such establishment in Hamburg. The plan contains a systematic assessment of the hazards linked with the establishments, and the list gives, for each named operator, the inspection interval, from yearly to every five years, the other establishments with which domino effects are possible, special surrounding hazard sources, and the date of the last inspection. Named operators include industrial gas, chemical, aviation fuel, tank storage and port container terminal companies. It is published by the Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA) of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg. Coverage is the city of Hamburg; the page is dated 9 March 2026 and the annex March 2026. The plan and annex are free PDF files. Caveats: the list is a PDF table without coordinates, the licence is not stated, and details of hazards are summarised, not published per site. For simulation it names which industrial sites in a major port could trigger one another, supporting cascading failure, exposure and emergency response studies. It is related to the Thuringia Seveso establishments record in this catalogue.
